title: Satwik-Chirag Exit Hong Kong Open After Semifinal Loss
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, were eliminated from the Hong Kong Open after a straight-games loss in the semifinals.
summary: The world No. 6 Indian pair, aiming for a third title this year, suffered an 18-21, 19-21 loss to Man-Tee.

title: Lakshya Sen Faces Antonsen in Hong Kong Open Semifinal Today
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen is set to compete in the men's singles semifinal of the Hong Kong Open against Anders Antonsen.
summary: Live streaming and broadcast information for the Hong Kong Open 2026 men’s singles semifinal between Lakshya Sen and Anders Antonsen on Saturday, November 21.

title: Rising Star Rakshitha Stuns Olympic Champion Chen Yu Fei
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Rakshitha achieved a career-defining victory by defeating Tokyo Olympics champion Chen Yu Fei.
summary: The 19-year-old Indian overcame a 10-point deficit in the second game to win the biggest match of her career so far against her idol.

title: Saina Nehwal Considers Bid for IOA President's Post
indian_angle: Former world No.1 Indian shuttler Saina Nehwal has expressed her willingness to contest for the Indian Olympic Association president's position.
summary: The former world No.1 shuttler stated she will not shy away from stepping up for the top administrative role.

title: Lakshya Sen, Satwik-Chirag Advance to Hong Kong Open Semifinals
indian_angle: Both Lakshya Sen and the men's doubles pair of Satwik-Chirag secured their spots in the semifinals of the Hong Kong Open.
summary: Sen, already qualified for the BWF World Tour Finals, won 21-17, 10-21, 21-13, while the doubles pair also progressed.
